method.prompt: Photorealistic dawn attic room, frost on the inside of a small window. a barefoot girl of about nine with reddish-gold hair under a patched gray coat, clutching a bundle of matchboxes wraps a thin shawl, tucks the match bundle inside her coat, and steps out into the cold morning. Slow pull-back. Floorboard creaks, thin blanket rustle, distant rooster, cold wind under the door.
